skip_reasons.wa_dragontail_peak_colchuck_col_buttress: No page describes a route by this name. Tried web searches (extended), the Mountain Project Dragontail and Colchuck pages, mountaineers.org and mountain-school listings; only the snow route to the col and other routes appear. Stored pitches 5.
skip_reasons.wa_dragontail_peak_northwest_face: No pitch-level text for a Beckey-Davis 1962 line on Dragontail; the 1962 Beckey-Davis hit is on Prusik Peak. Only Serpentine Ridge (14) and Backbone Ridge (12) are described, which are different routes. Stored pitches 3.
skip_reasons.wa_east_mcmillan_spire_northeast_buttres: Read the AAC first-ascent account (29 pitches, no per-pitch text; 7 pitches to first ledge, 14 new pitches to the bivy ledge) and the Alpinist news item (25 pitches). Stored 25 vs 29 in AAC; no one-by-one description exists on Mountain Project.
skip_reasons.wa_east_twin_needle_north_buttress: Read the full AAC account: nine roped pitches (matches stored 9) but described in groups (1-2, 4-7, one long final 5.9 pitch), pitch 3 not described, no per-pitch grades or lengths. Not one by one.
skip_reasons.wa_garfield_mountain_east_rib: No page names a Garfield Mountain East Rib; the Mountain Project Mount Garfield area, WTA reports and cascadeclimber page show only other routes and an east ridge scramble. Stored pitches 3.
